en.s: The Battle of Leuctra (Ancient Greek: Λεῦκτρα, Ancient Greek: [lêu̯k.tra]) was fought on 6 July 371 BC between the Boeotians led by the Thebans, and the Spartans along with their allies. The battle occurred in the context of the King's Peace, or Peace of Antalcidas, which had ended the Corinthian War in 386 BC.

zh.s: 留克特拉战役（古希腊语：Λεῦκτρα，读音：[lêu̯k.tra]）于公元前371年7月6日爆发，交战双方是底比斯人率领的波奥蒂亚人，以及斯巴达人及其盟友。战役发生在《大王和约》（又称《安塔尔基达斯和约》）签订后的历史背景下；该和约于公元前386年结束了科林斯战争。

en.s: The Battle of Heliopolis or Ayn Shams was a decisive battle in 640 between Arab Muslim armies and Byzantine Empire forces for the control of Egypt. Though there were several major skirmishes after this battle, it effectively decided the fate of the Byzantine rule in Egypt, and opened the door for the Muslim conquest of the Roman Exarchate of Africa.

zh.s: 赫利奥波利斯之战，又称艾因·沙姆斯之战，是640年阿拉伯穆斯林军队与拜占庭帝国军队为争夺埃及控制权而进行的一场决战。此后虽仍发生过几场重要交战，但这场战役基本决定了拜占庭对埃及统治的命运，也为穆斯林征服罗马帝国阿非利加总督区打开了道路。

en.s: The Battle of Pressburg (German: Schlacht von Pressburg), or Battle of Pozsony (Hungarian: Pozsonyi csata), or Battle of Bratislava (Slovak: bitka pri Bratislave) was a three-day-long battle fought between 4 and 6 July 907, during which the East Francian army, consisting mainly of Bavarian troops led by Margrave Luitpold, was annihilated by Hungarian forces. The exact location of the battle is not known.

zh.s: 普雷斯堡战役（德语：Schlacht von Pressburg；匈牙利语：Pozsonyi csata；斯洛伐克语：bitka pri Bratislave）是一场持续三天的战斗，于907年7月4日至6日进行。由卢伊特波尔德边疆侯爵率领、以巴伐利亚军队为主的东法兰克军队被匈牙利军队全歼。战斗的确切地点不详。

en.s: The Battle of Estercuel took place on 6 July 975 between the forces of the Kingdom of Viguera, under king Ramiro Garcés, and those of the Caliphate of Córdoba, under the kaid of Zaragoza, al-Tuyibi. The battle, a typical skirmish of the Christian–Muslim frontier, was a victory for the Caliphate. Several leading Navarrese magnates were killed and Ramiro was injured. The kaid of Zaragoza had been a participant in the campaign of Galib ibn Abd al-Rahman in the spring, but he appears to have left the expedition before the victory at the Battle of San Esteban de Gormaz in 978.

zh.s: 埃斯特库埃尔战役于975年7月6日爆发，交战双方分别是维格拉王国国王拉米罗·加尔塞斯率领的军队，以及由萨拉戈萨总督阿图伊比率领的科尔多瓦哈里发国军队。这是一场典型的基督教与穆斯林边境冲突，最终由哈里发国获胜。纳瓦拉几位重要贵族阵亡，拉米罗受伤。萨拉戈萨总督曾在当年春季参加加利卜·伊本·阿卜杜勒-拉赫曼的战役，但据称在978年圣埃斯特万-德-戈尔马斯战役获胜前已离开远征军。

en.t: The reunion of the Catholic and Orthodox Church is proclaimed and celebrated with a public holiday
en.s: The Eastern Orthodox Church, officially the Orthodox Catholic Church, also known as the Greek Orthodox Church is the second-largest Christian body in the world after the Roman Catholic Church, and one of the three major doctrinal and jurisdictional groups of Christianity. The Eastern Orthodox Church operates as a communion of autocephalous churches, each governed by its bishops via local synods.

zh.s: 东正教会的正式名称是正教大公教会，也称希腊正教会。它是世界第二大基督教团体，仅次于罗马天主教会，也是基督教三大教义与管辖体系之一。东正教会由多个自主教会组成共融体，各教会由主教通过地方主教会议治理。

zh.s: 卡斯蒂奥内战役于1449年7月6日爆发，交战双方是米兰的金色安布罗斯共和国和乌里州。战场靠近更早发生的阿尔贝多战役遗址；两处遗址都位于瑞士提契诺州现今阿尔贝多-卡斯蒂奥内市镇境内。

en.s: Anne Neville (11 June 1456 – 16 March 1485) was Queen of England from 26 June 1483 until her death in 1485 as the wife of King Richard III. She was the younger of the two daughters and co-heiresses of Richard Neville, 16th Earl of Warwick (the "Kingmaker"), and Anne Beauchamp, 16th Countess of Warwick.

zh.t: 理查三世与安妮·内维尔加冕为英格兰国王和王后
zh.s: 安妮·内维尔（1456年6月11日—1485年3月16日）自1483年6月26日起成为英格兰王后，直至1485年去世；她是理查三世的妻子。她是第十六代沃里克伯爵理查·内维尔（“造王者”）与第十六代沃里克女伯爵安妮·博尚的两个女儿中较小的一位，也是两人的共同继承人之一。

en.t: Coronation of Richard III of England
en.s: Richard III (2 October 1452 – 22 August 1485) was King of England from 26 June 1483 until his death in 1485. He was the last king of the Plantagenet dynasty and its cadet branch, the House of York; the former had ruled England since 1154. His defeat and death at the Battle of Bosworth Field marked the end of the Middle Ages in England.

zh.t: 英格兰国王理查三世加冕
zh.s: 理查三世（1452年10月2日—1485年8月22日）自1483年6月26日起担任英格兰国王，直至1485年去世。他是金雀花王朝及其分支约克王朝的最后一位国王；金雀花王朝自1154年起统治英格兰。他在博斯沃思原野战役中战败身亡，标志着英格兰中世纪的结束。

en.s: The Battle of Fornovo took place 30 km (19 miles) southwest of the city of Parma on 6 July 1495. The Holy League, an alliance comprising notably the Republic of Venice, was able to temporarily expel the French from the Italian Peninsula. It was the first major battle of the Italian Wars.

zh.s: 福尔诺沃战役于1495年7月6日在帕尔马市西南30公里（19英里）处爆发。神圣同盟是一个以威尼斯共和国为重要成员的联盟，曾暂时将法国人逐出意大利半岛。这是意大利战争中的第一场重大战役。

en.s: Jacques Cartier (Breton: Jakez Karter; 31 December 1491 – 1 September 1557) was a French maritime explorer from Brittany. Jacques Cartier was the first European to describe and map the Gulf of Saint Lawrence and the shores of the Saint Lawrence River, which he named "Canada" after the Iroquoian names for the two big settlements he saw at Stadacona (Quebec City) and at Hochelaga (Montreal Island).

zh.t: 探险家雅克·卡蒂埃结束第二次北美远征，在圣马洛登陆。他没有带回预期会找到的黄金
zh.s: 雅克·卡蒂埃（布列塔尼语：Jakez Karter；1491年12月31日—1557年9月1日）是来自布列塔尼的法国航海探险家。他是首位描述并绘制圣劳伦斯湾及圣劳伦斯河沿岸地图的欧洲人；他以“加拿大”称呼该地区，名称取自他在斯塔达科纳（魁北克市）和奥什拉加（蒙特利尔岛）见到的易洛魁人两处大型聚居地的名称。

en.t: Thomas More is executed after having been condemned on perjured evidence
en.s: Sir Thomas More (7 February 1478 – 6 July 1535), venerated in the Catholic Church as a martyr and saint, was an English lawyer, judge, social philosopher, author, statesman, theologian and Renaissance humanist. He also served Henry VIII as Lord Chancellor from October 1529 to May 1532. He wrote Utopia, published in 1516, which describes the political system of an imaginary island state.

zh.t: 托马斯·莫尔因伪证定罪后被处决
zh.s: 托马斯·莫尔爵士（1478年2月7日—1535年7月6日）在天主教会中被尊为殉道者和圣人，是英国律师、法官、社会哲学家、作家、政治家、神学家和文艺复兴人文主义者。1529年10月至1532年5月，他还担任亨利八世的大法官。他于1516年出版《乌托邦》，书中描绘了一个虚构岛国的政治制度。

en.t: Córdoba, Argentina, is founded by Jerónimo Luis de Cabrera
en.s: Córdoba (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈkoɾðoβa]) is a city in central Argentina, in the foothills of the Sierras Chicas on the Suquía River, about 700 km (435 mi) northwest of Buenos Aires. It is the capital of Córdoba Province and the second-most populous city in Argentina after Buenos Aires, with about 1.6 million urban inhabitants according to the 2020 census.

zh.t: 杰罗尼莫·路易斯·德·卡夫雷拉建立阿根廷科尔多瓦
zh.s: 科尔多瓦（西班牙语发音：[ˈkoɾðoβa]）是阿根廷中部的一座城市，位于奇卡斯山脉山麓、苏基亚河畔，距布宜诺斯艾利斯西北约700公里（435英里）。它是科尔多瓦省首府，也是阿根廷人口第二多的城市，仅次于布宜诺斯艾利斯；根据2020年人口普查，城市人口约160万。

en.s: The Raid on Żejtun, also known as The Last Attack (Maltese: L-aħħar ħbit), was the last major attack made by the Ottoman Empire against Hospitaller-ruled Malta. The attack took place in July 1614, when raiders pillaged the town of Żejtun and the surrounding area before being beaten back to their ships by the Order's cavalry and by the inhabitants of the south-eastern towns and villages.
en.n: Raid on Żejtun: The south east of Malta, and the town of Żejtun, suffer a raid from Ottoman forces. This was the last unsuccessful attempt by the Ottomans to conquer the island of Malta.

zh.s: 1614年7月，奥斯曼帝国军队袭击医院骑士团统治下的马耳他，这是奥斯曼帝国对马耳他的最后一次大规模进攻。袭击者洗劫了泽伊通镇及周边地区，随后被骑士团骑兵和马耳他东南部村镇居民击退，逃回船上。

en.s: The Battle of La Marfée took place during Thirty Years' War near Sedan, France, on 6 July 1641, between a Royal army of Louis XIII under Marshall Gaspard III de Coligny, and French malcontents led by Prince Louis de Bourbon, Count of Soissons, and Duke Frédéric Maurice de La Tour d'Auvergne, duc de Bouillon, who were supported by an Imperial-Spanish army under general Guillaume de Lamboy sent from the Spanish Netherlands by the Cardinal-Infante Ferdinand of Austria. The French malcontents and the Habsburg forces dealt a serious defeat to the French Royal Army, and for a moment, Cardinal Richelieu feared that the rebels, supported by the Spanish forces, would advance on Paris.

zh.s: 1641年7月6日，三十年战争期间，法国色当附近爆发拉马尔费战役。路易十三的王军由加斯帕尔三世·德·科利尼元帅率领；反叛的法国人由苏瓦松伯爵、波旁亲王路易和布永公爵弗雷德里克·莫里斯·德·拉图尔·奥弗涅率领，并得到一支帝国—西班牙联军支持。联军由纪尧姆·德·朗布瓦将军指挥，受奥地利枢机亲王斐迪南派遣，从西属尼德兰赶来。法国叛军和哈布斯堡军队重创了法国王军。一度，红衣主教黎塞留担心在西班牙军队支持下的叛军会向巴黎推进。

en.s: The battle of Tarragona fought between 4 and 6 July 1641, was a naval engagement of the Reapers' War in which a Spanish galley fleet led by the Duke of Fernandina attempted to break the French naval blockade of Tarragona, at that time besieged by land by the French and Catalan armies under the French Viceroy of Catalonia.

zh.s: 1641年7月4日至6日，收割者战争期间爆发塔拉戈纳海战。费尔南迪纳公爵率领的西班牙桨帆船舰队试图打破法国海军对塔拉戈纳的封锁。当时，法国副王率领的法国和加泰罗尼亚军队正在陆上围攻该城。

en.s: The Battle of Loyew (Belarusian: Бітва пад Лоевам, Ukrainian: Битва під Лоєвом, Polish: Bitwa pod Łojowem; 6 July 1651) was fought between the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth against the Cossack Hetmanate as a part of the Khmelnytsky Uprising. Near the site of the present-day town of Loyew on the Sozh River in Belarus, the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth’s forces under the command of Prince Janusz Radziwiłł and Mirski attacked and defeated a forces of the Zaporozhian Cossacks under the command of Colonels Martyn Nebaba, Stepan Pobodailo and Prokip Shumeyko with Lytvynenko.

zh.s: 洛耶夫战役（白俄罗斯语：Бітва пад Лоевам；乌克兰语：Битва під Лоєвом；波兰语：Bitwa pod Łojowem）于1651年7月6日爆发，是赫梅利尼茨基起义的一部分，交战双方为波兰立陶宛联邦和哥萨克盖特曼国。战场靠近白俄罗斯索日河畔的洛耶夫镇现址。扬努什·拉齐维乌亲王和米尔斯基指挥的波兰立陶宛联邦军队进攻并击败了扎波罗热哥萨克军队；后者由马尔滕·涅巴巴、斯捷潘·波博戴洛和普罗基普·舒梅伊科等上校指挥，利特维年科也在其中。

en.s: The Battle of Sedgemoor was fought on 6 July 1685 and took place at Westonzoyland near Bridgwater in Somerset, England. It was the final battle of the Monmouth Rebellion and followed a series of skirmishes around south west England between the forces of James Scott, 1st Duke of Monmouth and troops loyal to James II. Victory went to the royalists and about 500 prisoners fell into their hands. Monmouth escaped from the battlefield but was later captured and taken to London for trial and execution. Many of Monmouth's supporters were tried during the Bloody Assizes.

zh.s: 塞奇穆尔战役于1685年7月6日在英格兰萨默塞特郡布里奇沃特附近的西顿佐伊兰德爆发，是蒙茅斯叛乱的最后一场战役。此前，詹姆斯·斯科特（蒙茅斯公爵）率领的部队与效忠詹姆斯二世的军队已在英格兰西南部发生一系列小规模冲突。王党获胜，俘虏约500人。蒙茅斯逃离战场，但后来被捕并押往伦敦受审、处决。他的许多支持者在“血腥巡回审判”中受审。

en.s: The 1777 Siege of Fort Ticonderoga occurred between 2 and 6 July 1777 at Fort Ticonderoga, near the southern end of Lake Champlain in the state of New York. Lieutenant General John Burgoyne's 8,000-man army occupied high ground above the fort, and nearly surrounded the defences. These movements precipitated the occupying Continental Army, an under-strength force of 3,000 under the command of General Arthur St. Clair, to withdraw from Ticonderoga and the surrounding defences. Some gunfire was exchanged, and there were some casualties, but there was no formal siege and no pitched battle.

zh.t: 蒂康德罗加堡围城战（1777年）
zh.s: 1777年蒂康德罗加堡围城战于1777年7月2日至6日在纽约州尚普兰湖南端附近的蒂康德罗加堡发生。约翰·伯戈因中将率领8000人的军队占据堡垒上方的高地，几乎包围了防线。此举促使驻守此地的大陆军撤退；这支兵力不足的部队有3000人，由阿瑟·圣克莱尔将军指挥。双方发生了一些交火并有人伤亡，但没有正式围城，也没有大规模会战。

en.s: The Battle of Grenada took place on 6 July 1779 during the Anglo-French War in the West Indies between the British Royal Navy and the French Navy, just off the coast of Grenada. The British fleet of Admiral John Byron (the grandfather of Lord Byron) had sailed in an attempt to relieve Grenada, which the French forces of the Comte D'Estaing had just captured. Incorrectly believing he had numerical superiority, Byron ordered a general chase to attack the French as they left their anchorage at Grenada. Because of the disorganized attack and the French superiority, the British fleet was badly mauled in the encounter, although no ships were lost.

zh.s: 1779年7月6日，西印度群岛的格林纳达海岸附近爆发格林纳达海战。交战双方是英国皇家海军和法国海军，战事发生在英法西印度战争期间。约翰·拜伦海军上将（拜伦勋爵的祖父）率领英国舰队出航，试图夺回刚被德斯坦伯爵的法军攻占的格林纳达。拜伦误以为己方兵力占优，于是下令全舰追击，趁法军离开格林纳达锚地时发动攻击。由于英军进攻混乱且法军占优，英国舰队在交战中遭受重创，但没有舰船损失。

en.s: The Battle of Green Spring took place near Green Spring Plantation in James City County, Virginia during the American Revolutionary War. On July 6, 1781 United States Brigadier General "Mad" Anthony Wayne, leading the advance forces of the Marquis de Lafayette, was ambushed near the plantation by the British army of Earl Charles Cornwallis in the last major land battle of the Virginia campaign prior to the Siege of Yorktown. Following a month of marching and countermarching in central Virginia by Cornwallis and Lafayette, Cornwallis in late June moved to Williamsburg, where he received orders to move to Portsmouth and send some of his army to New York City.

zh.s: 美国独立战争期间，绿泉战役在弗吉尼亚州詹姆斯城县的绿泉种植园附近爆发。1781年7月6日，美国准将“疯子”安东尼·韦恩率领拉斐特侯爵的先头部队，在种植园附近遭到查尔斯·康沃利斯伯爵率领的英军伏击。这是约克镇围城战前弗吉尼亚战役中最后一场重大的陆战。此前一个月，康沃利斯和拉斐特的军队在弗吉尼亚中部来回行军。6月下旬，康沃利斯转移到威廉斯堡，并接到命令前往朴次茅斯，同时派遣部分军队去纽约市。

en.s: The Battle of Negapatam was the third in a series of battles fought between a British fleet, under Vice-Admiral Sir Edward Hughes, and a French fleet, under the Bailli de Suffren, off the coast of India during the American Revolutionary War. The battle was fought on 6 July 1782. Though the battle was indecisive, Suffren was stopped in his goal by Hughes and withdrew to Cuddalore, while the British remained in control of Negapatam.

zh.s: 美国独立战争期间，英国和法国舰队在印度海岸先后进行了多场海战，1782年内加帕塔姆海战是其中第三场。英军由爱德华·休斯爵士中将指挥，法军由苏弗朗骑士指挥。战斗于1782年7月6日爆发，未分胜负；休斯阻止了苏弗朗的计划，后者撤往库达洛尔，英军则继续控制内加帕塔姆。

en.s: The Sheikh Mansur movement, was a major war between the Russian Empire and the North Caucasians, caused by the Chechen religious and military leader Sheikh Mansur, who opposed the Russian expansionist policies and wanted to unite the North Caucasians under a single Islamic state. Starting off as a failed Russian campaign to capture Sheikh Mansur, who had spread Islam among the Chechens, it quickly turned to a region-wide anti-Russian insurgency.

zh.s: 谢赫曼苏尔运动是俄罗斯帝国与北高加索人之间的一场重大战争，由反对俄罗斯扩张、希望将北高加索人统一在一个伊斯兰国家之下的车臣宗教和军事领袖谢赫·曼苏尔引发。战争最初是俄军试图抓捕谢赫·曼苏尔但未能成功的军事行动；他曾在车臣人中传播伊斯兰教，行动很快演变为席卷整个地区的反俄起义。

zh.t: 利奥波德二世在帕多瓦呼吁欧洲君主与他共同要求法国国王路易十六获释
zh.s: 利奥波德二世（彼得·利奥波德·约瑟夫·安东·约阿希姆·皮乌斯·戈特哈德；1747年5月5日—1792年3月1日）是倒数第二位神圣罗马皇帝，1790年至1792年间还担任匈牙利、克罗地亚和波希米亚国王及奥地利大公；1765年至1790年间，他以利奥波德一世之名担任托斯卡纳大公。

en.s: The First Battle of Algeciras was a naval battle fought on 6 July 1801 (17 messidor an IX of the French Republican Calendar) between a squadron of British Royal Navy ships of the line and a smaller French Navy squadron at anchor in the fortified Spanish port of Algeciras in the Strait of Gibraltar. The British outnumbered their opponents, but the French position was protected by Spanish gun batteries and the complicated shoals that obscured the entrance to Algeciras Bay.

zh.t: 第一次阿尔赫西拉斯海战
zh.s: 第一次阿尔赫西拉斯海战于1801年7月6日（法国共和历共和九年牧月17日）爆发，交战双方是英国皇家海军的一支战列舰分舰队和一支规模较小、停泊在西班牙要塞港阿尔赫西拉斯的法国海军分舰队。阿尔赫西拉斯位于直布罗陀海峡。英军舰船数量占优，但法军阵地受到西班牙炮台和复杂浅滩的保护，浅滩也遮挡了阿尔赫西拉斯湾入口。

en.s: The Battle of Wagram ([ˈvaɡram]; 5–6 July 1809) was a military engagement of the Napoleonic Wars that ended in a costly but decisive victory for Emperor Napoleon's French and allied army against the Austrian army under the command of Archduke Charles of Austria-Teschen. The battle led to the breakup of the Fifth Coalition, the Austrian and British-led alliance against France.

zh.s: 瓦格拉姆战役（[ˈvaɡram]）于1809年7月5日至6日爆发，是拿破仑战争中的一场战斗。拿破仑的法国及盟军击败了由奥地利泰申大公卡尔指挥的奥地利军队，取得代价高昂但具有决定性的胜利。战役导致第五次反法同盟解体；该同盟由奥地利和英国等国组成。

en.s: The Battle of Lyngør was fought on 6 July 1812 between the British and Dano-Norwegian navies as part of the Gunboat War. A British squadron of one ship of the line and three brig-sloops under James Stewart located the Dano-Norwegian frigate Najaden sheltering off Lyngør, and engaged and destroyed her in a fierce engagement; Najaden's captain Hans Peter Holm was wounded but survived, but 133 of his crew were killed and a further 87 wounded.

zh.s: 灵厄尔海战于1812年7月6日爆发，是炮艇战争的一部分，交战双方为英国海军和丹麦—挪威海军。詹姆斯·斯图尔特率领一支英国分舰队，包括一艘战列舰和三艘双桅纵帆船，在灵厄尔附近发现了正在避风的丹麦—挪威护卫舰“纳亚登”号。激战后，英军将其击沉。“纳亚登”号舰长汉斯·彼得·霍尔姆受伤但幸存，舰上133人阵亡，另有87人受伤。

en.s: The 1812 Louisiana gubernatorial election was the first gubernatorial election to take place after Louisiana achieved statehood. The returns were sent to the President of the Louisiana State Senate.

en.s: The Battle of Rincón de Valladares (6 July 1827) was a battle during the Argentine Civil Wars. It was fought between Federalist forces led by Facundo Quiroga and Unitarian forces under Governor Gregorio Aráoz de Lamadrid, near the city of San Miguel de Tucumán. Quiroga was the victor, forcing Lamadrid to resign and go into exile in Bolivia, leaving the government of Tucumán Province in the hands of the Federalists.

zh.s: 巴利亚达雷斯角战役于1827年7月6日爆发，是阿根廷内战的一场战斗。交战双方是法昆多·基罗加率领的联邦派部队，以及格雷戈里奥·阿劳斯·德·拉马德里德州长率领的统一派部队，战场在圣米格尔-德图库曼市附近。基罗加获胜，迫使拉马德里德辞职并流亡玻利维亚，图库曼省政府因此落入联邦派手中。

en.s: The Battle of Sikkak was a battle within the 2nd Karedian War during the French conquest of Algeria period. It saw French and Emirate of Mascara forces clash in one of the last of and one of only a few large battles fought since the end of the initial invasion in 1830.

zh.s: 西卡克之战是法国征服阿尔及利亚时期第二次卡雷迪亚战争中的一场战斗，交战双方为法军和马斯卡拉酋长国军队。1830年最初入侵结束后，大规模战斗为数不多；西卡克之战是其中最后几场之一。

en.s: The 1840–41 United States House of Representatives elections were held on various dates in various states between July 6, 1840, and November 2, 1841. Each state set its own date for its elections to the House of Representatives, before or after the first session of the 27th United States Congress convened on May 31, 1841. Elections were held for all 242 seats, representing 26 states.

zh.s: 1840—1841年美国众议院选举在各州分别举行，日期从1840年7月6日至1841年11月2日不等。各州自行决定众议院选举日期，可能早于或晚于1841年5月31日召开的第27届美国国会第一次会议。此次选举涉及代表26个州的全部242个席位。

en.s: The Modoc War, or the Modoc Campaign (also known as the Lava Beds War), was an armed conflict between the Native American Modoc people and the United States Army in northeastern California and southeastern Oregon between 1872 and 1873. The fighting was in response to the California genocide, when agents of the United States government assisted by private citizens began the systematic killing of thousands of indigenous peoples of California in the mid-19th century.

zh.s: 莫多克战争（又称莫多克战役或熔岩床战争）是1872至1873年间发生在美国东北加利福尼亚州和俄勒冈州东南部的一场武装冲突，交战双方为美洲原住民莫多克人和美国陆军。冲突起因是加利福尼亚种族灭绝：19世纪中叶，美国政府官员在私人协助下开始系统性屠杀加利福尼亚州数千名原住民。

en.s: The Hawaiian rebellions and revolutions took place in Hawaii between 1887 and 1895. en.s: The New Zealand Liberal leadership election, 1889 was held on 6 July 1889 to choose who would lead New Zealand's parliamentary opposition and, ultimately, decide the inaugural leader of the New Zealand Liberal Party. The election was won by Wanganui MP John Ballance.

en.s: The Homestead strike, also known as the Homestead steel strike, Homestead massacre, or Battle of Homestead, was an industrial lockout and strike that occurred in Pennsylvania in the United States, in 1892. It began on July 1, 1892, culminating in a battle in which strikers defeated private security agents on July 6, 1892. The governor responded by sending in the National Guard to protect strikebreakers.
en.n: Three thousand eight hundred striking steelworkers engage in a day-long battle with Pinkerton agents during the Homestead Strike, leaving ten dead and dozens wounded.

zh.s: 霍姆斯特德罢工（又称霍姆斯特德钢铁工人罢工、霍姆斯特德惨案或霍姆斯特德战役）是1892年发生在美国宾夕法尼亚州的一场劳资封锁和罢工。罢工于1892年7月1日开始，7月6日爆发战斗，罢工者击败了私人保安人员。州长随后派出国民警卫队保护罢工替代工人。

en.s: The Arab Revolt (Arabic: الثورة العربية al-Thawra al-'Arabiyya), also known as the Great Arab Revolt (الثورة العربية الكبرى al-Thawra al-'Arabiyya al-Kubrā), was an armed uprising by the Hashemite-led Arabs of the Hejaz against the Ottoman Empire amidst the Middle Eastern theatre of World War I. On the basis of the McMahon–Hussein Correspondence, exchanged between Henry McMahon of the United Kingdom and Hussein bin Ali of the Kingdom of Hejaz, the rebellion against the ruling Turks was officially initiated at Mecca on 10 June 1916.
en.n: World War I: Arabian troops led by T. E. Lawrence ("Lawrence of Arabia") and Auda ibu Tayi capture Aqaba from the Ottoman Empire during the Arab Revolt.

zh.s: 阿拉伯起义（阿拉伯语：الثورة العربية，al-Thawra al-'Arabiyya），又称大阿拉伯起义（الثورة العربية الكبرى，al-Thawra al-'Arabiyya al-Kubrā），是第一次世界大战中东战场期间，由哈希姆家族领导的汉志阿拉伯人反抗奥斯曼帝国的武装起义。根据英国亨利·麦克马洪与汉志王国侯赛因·本·阿里之间交换的《麦克马洪—侯赛因通信》，针对土耳其统治者的叛乱于1916年6月10日在麦加正式爆发。
zh.n: 第一次世界大战：T·E·劳伦斯（“阿拉伯的劳伦斯”）和奥达·伊本·塔伊率领阿拉伯军队，在阿拉伯起义期间从奥斯曼帝国手中夺取亚喀巴。

en.t: The first National Political Consultative Conference opens
en.s: The National Political Consultative Conference was a political organization of the National Government of the Republic of China. It was the highest national consultative and deliberative body for public opinion, with representatives from the Kuomintang, the Chinese Communist Party, and other anti-Japanese parties and non-partisans participating. It was established in July 1938 and ended in March 1948. It also had a Constitutional Council.

The convoy sailed from Southend-on-Sea in the Thames Estuary on 3 July 1940 via the English Channel, where local traffic dispersed to south coast ports. en.t: The Story Bridge in Brisbane, the longest cantilever bridge in Australia, was opened by Sir Leslie Wilson, Governor of Queensland
en.s: The Story Bridge is a heritage-listed steel cantilever bridge spanning the Brisbane River built to carry vehicular, bicycle and pedestrian traffic between the northern and southern suburbs of Brisbane, Queensland, Australia. It is the longest cantilever bridge in Australia. The road across the bridge is named Bradfield Highway. The bridge connects Fortitude Valley to Kangaroo Point. The Story Bridge opened in 1940 and was tolled until 1947.

en.s: The Landing at Nassau Bay was an amphibious landing by Allied forces at Nassau Bay during the New Guinea campaign of World War II that took place between 30 June and 6 July 1943. en.s: The Nigerian Civil War, better known as the Biafran War, (6 July 1967 – 15 January 1970), was a war fought to counter the secession of Biafra from Nigeria. Biafra represented nationalist aspirations of the then Eastern Nigeria now South East and South South regions, whose leadership felt they could no longer coexist with the Northern-dominated federal government. The conflict resulted from political, economic, ethnic, cultural and religious tensions which preceded Britain's formal decolonisation of Nigeria from 1960 to 1963. Immediate causes of the war in 1966 included a military coup, a counter-coup, and persecution of Igbo living in Northern Nigeria.

zh.s: 尼日利亚内战又称比夫拉战争，发生于1967年7月6日至1970年1月15日，是一场为阻止比夫拉脱离尼日利亚而爆发的战争。比夫拉代表当时尼日利亚东部（今东南部和南南部地区）的民族主义诉求，当地领导人认为，他们已无法与北部主导的联邦政府共存。冲突源于政治、经济、族群、文化和宗教方面的紧张局势，这些矛盾早于英国在1960至1963年间正式结束对尼日利亚的殖民统治。战争在1966年的直接起因包括军事政变、反政变，以及对居住在尼日利亚北部的伊博人的迫害。

en.s: The South Korean presidential election of 1978 took place on 6 July 1978 and was the second election held under the framework of the Yushin Constitution. Park Chung-hee was elected, as in 1972, without opposition. Elections to the National Council for Reunification, the electoral college specified by the constitution, took place on 18 May, and Park Chung-hee was subsequently elected with the support of 2,578 members out of 2,581. One vote was declared invalid, the two remaining delegates were not present. Park Chung Hee would continue in office for just over a year before his assassination on 26 October 1979 and the subsequent collapse of the Yushin system.

zh.s: 1978年韩国总统选举于7月6日举行，是《维新宪法》框架下的第二次总统选举。朴正熙与1972年一样，在没有对手的情况下当选。宪法规定的选举团——统一主体国民会议——于5月18日举行选举，随后朴正熙获得2,581名成员中的2,578人支持而当选。1票无效，另有2名代表缺席。朴正熙继续执政一年多，直到1979年10月26日遇刺，维新体制随后瓦解。

en.s: General elections were held in México on July 6, 1988. Carlos Salinas de Gortari was declared the winner, with the Ministry of Interior saying he had received 50.7% of the vote. It was the lowest for a winning candidate since direct elections were introduced for the presidency in 1917. In the Chamber of Deputies election, the Institutional Revolutionary Party won 260 of the 500 seats, as well as winning 60 of the 64 seats in the Senate election. Voter turnout was said to be 51.6% in the presidential election, 49.7% for the Senate elections and 49.4% for the Chamber election.

en.s: On July 6, 2013, at approximately 1:14 a.m. EDT, an unattended 73-car Montreal, Maine and Atlantic Railway (MMA) freight train carrying Bakken Formation crude oil rolled down a 1.2% grade and derailed in downtown Lac-Mégantic, resulting in the explosion and fire of multiple tank cars. Forty-seven people were killed.

en.s: The 2019 Super Rugby Final was played between the Crusaders of New Zealand and the Jaguares of Argentina. It was the 24th final in the Super Rugby competition's history. en.s: The 2019 Supercupa României was the 21st edition of Romania's season opener cup competition. en.s: Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky Air Flight 251 (PTK251) was a domestic Russian scheduled passenger flight from Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky to Palana, both in Kamchatka Krai in the Russian Far East. en.t: The Georgia Guidestones, a monument in the United States, are heavily damaged in a bombing, and are dismantled later the same day
en.s: The Georgia Guidestones was a granite monument that stood in Elbert County, Georgia, United States, from 1980 to 2022. It was 19 feet 3 inches (5.87 m) tall and made from six granite slabs weighing a total of 237,746 pounds (107,840 kg). The structure was sometimes referred to as an "American Stonehenge".

en.s: The 2025 CONCACAF Gold Cup final was a soccer match to determine the winner of the 2025 CONCACAF Gold Cup. The match was the 18th final of the Gold Cup, a biennial tournament contested by the men's national teams representing the member associations of CONCACAF and an invited guest to decide the champion of North America, Central America, and the Caribbean. The match was held at NRG Stadium in Houston, Texas, United States, on July 6, 2025, and was contested by two rival, neighboring teams of the United States and Mexico.
